name: Ballarat NetConnect
summary: Ballarat ISP (NetConnect Communications Pty Ltd, ACN 065 871 927, est. 1994). Its principals joined Chariot Limited by FY2003-04 (2004 Annual Report lists NetConnect's former CEO Ian as Chariot's General Manager and founding shareholder Gary at Chariot; Ballarat listed among Chariot's offices). The 'Chariot netconnect' brand used from c. 2004 derives from this NetConnect lineage; netconnect.com.au served Chariot's Ballarat/VIC page by Apr 2006 and redirected to vic.chariot.net.au from Jan 2007 (brand's last use).

events.details: Absorbed into Chariot Limited: NetConnect's former CEO Ian is listed as Chariot General Manager and founding shareholder Gary at Chariot in the FY2003-04 Annual Report (Executive Team), with Ballarat among Chariot's offices. The 'Chariot netconnect' brand (in use by c. 2004-05) derives from this lineage. By Apr 2006 netconnect.com.au already served Chariot's Ballarat/VIC page ('© Chariot', ABN 31 088 377 860); it 302-redirected to vic.chariot.net.au by Jan 2007 and 301-redirected to www.chariot.net.au by 2010 (brand's last use), not the acquisition.
